about:
Field to Fabric Quilt Company operates as an award-winning specialty quilt shop in downtown Winfield, Kansas. The business provides a full range of quilting supplies and offers longarm machine quilting services to customers throughout the region.

The shop distinguishes itself as the only quilt retailer in Kansas dedicated to DIY t-shirt quilts, assisting makers with project completion using a wide selection of color blenders. Inventory includes fabric by the bolt, notions, books, embroidery floss, and cross-stitch materials, alongside a rotating assortment of pre-cut quilt kits. A classroom space hosts regular sewing events, including monthly hand-work sessions and community shop-hop activities.

Field to Fabric serves individual quilters, crafters, and sewing enthusiasts rather than industrial buyers. The shop participates in the Central Kansas Quilt Shop Hop, the Border Run shop hop with stores in Wellington, Burden, and Ponca City, and the All Kansas/Nebraska Quilt Shop Hop, drawing visitors from across the multi-state region. These events feature exclusive fabrics, block kits, and finishing kits designed by the shop.

The company emphasizes project completion support, offering longarm quilting, color-blending guidance, and a schedule of open sewing days to help customers finish works in progress. Its focus on t-shirt quilt conversion and participation in regional hop events reflect a community-oriented approach to the craft retail market.
